components.html:
Only on this phone

Tasks stay on this phone. They are not backed up or shared yet.

narrative.overview: Orderly native Material 3 lists, evergreen controls, and the approved martial-arts rabbit. This sidecar documents the anonymous shell, not the planned shared release. HTML snippets are token previews, not Android rendering evidence.

rules.name: Task language
rules.body: Changing the interface language never translates task content.

dos: Keep the approved rabbit path unchanged.
Use native emulator screenshots to review the Android interface.
donts: Do not add nonfunctional voice or shared-navigation controls.
Do not claim cross-device sync from two independent offline queues.
